checks.name: App-only system source selection
checks.observation: The Android MediaProjection system flow offered single-app capture; the Clock app was selected. The emulator joined SHARE_TEST without a microphone, and its roster showed only the local participant.

checks.name: Android local preview
checks.observation: After returning to the existing BOOHTACORD Activity, the local viewer displayed a non-black portrait frame from Clock with the expected letterboxing inside the landscape viewer. MediaProjection remained active.

checks.name: Background and resume (microphone muted)
checks.observation: After BOOHTACORD was sent to Home for 10 seconds, dumpsys still showed TYPE_SCREEN_CAPTURE and the IsolateHolderService foreground with foreground-service type 0x20. Bringing the existing MainActivity forward preserved the visible local Clock preview.

checks.name: Stop and leave cleanup
checks.observation: Stopping from the voice dock cleared MediaProjection and the app foreground service. After leaving SHARE_TEST, the room roster refreshed to empty within approximately five seconds.

limitations: This is emulator acceptance, not a physical-device result. Background duration was 10 seconds and the microphone remained muted.
No paired browser or macOS receiver was connected; remote publication, decoded frames, receiver crop and paired metrics remain unverified.
The test does not establish microphone continuity in the background; that remains a separate FE-68 acceptance.
remaining: Repeat app-only and background/resume with a paired web or macOS receiver, correlate bounded sender/receiver frame counters, then separately test microphone-enabled background behavior if ADR-006 requires it.
